scope: Local WSL software GLES2, Proving Grounds split screen, both controllers driving.
method: Same app objects and verified resources except the render queue capacity. Exact 30-second swap windows after both cars moved. Counters use the 29 whole race samples inside each window. Both returned through Results and started a second race.
decision: Adopt capacity 256. Both orders reduced renderer handoffs and median swap spacing. The pending command-count ceiling doubles, with ownership and cancellation rules preserved. Physical iPad FPS, peak memory and energy have not been measured.
verification: The main-thread test and all 12 owned-renderer scenarios passed with the production bound. The trial also passed those checks under AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer.
